# Copilot Instructions for Mayfield-Cell-Phone-Repairs

## Project Overview
Mayfield Cell Phone Repairs is a website for a mobile device repair service located in Mayfield, NSW, Australia. The business specializes in cell phone repairs, iPad repairs, tablet repairs, and laptop repairs, with a focus on fast, reliable service in the Newcastle & Hunter area.

## Key Business Concepts
- **Services**: Core offerings include iPhone, iPad, MacBook, Apple Watch, Samsung, and general laptop repairs
- **Location**: 276 Maitland Rd, Mayfield, 2304, NSW, Australia
- **Trust**: Emphasize reputation and reliability, with no booking required for fast service
- **Content**: Blog posts on repair tips, device issues, and comparisons (e.g., Samsung vs Google AI phones, MacBook slowdown fixes)

## Development Guidelines
- Focus on user-friendly web design for customers seeking repair services
- Include contact information prominently: Phone 0240491735, Email mayfieldcellphonerepairs@gmail.com
- Ensure mobile-responsive design given the device repair focus
- Integrate social media links: Facebook, Instagram, YouTube
- Use modern, clean design similar to WordPress Repairer theme with Elementor

- `index.html`: Homepage with hero, services overview, recent blog posts
- `services.html`: Detailed services page

- `contact.html`: Contact form and details
- `blog/`: Directory for blog posts
- `assets/`: CSS, JS, images
- `README.md`: Contains business description
- `.github/copilot-instructions.md`: This file for AI guidance

- Social media links for Facebook, Instagram, YouTube
- Contact form integration (e.g., Formspree for static sites)
